environment.description: Node.js 18 container running on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with a standard HTTPS listener (ACM certificate, TLS 1.2+). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB forwards to target group on port 4000. No additional middleware or authentication layer. Upload directory is served via express.static and the container's ECS task role has no restrictive policies beyond ECR pull.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM cert, default action forward to TG
